basis: Stage 1: zero in-bounds exact nominal-pose dyads permit full input rotation, even at zero robustness margins.

experiments.change: Construct dyads at angles within the original plus/minus 3 degree tolerances; same exact position targets and all geometry bounds. Three additional radical-inverse coordinates use bases 7, 11 and 13.
Negate the perpendicular carrier offset at the same sampled magnitude; all other bounds unchanged.
Sample attachment fraction over [-1,0.01] instead of [0.01,0.99]; all other bounds unchanged.
Sample attachment fraction over [0.99,2] instead of [0.01,0.99]; all other bounds unchanged.

Use baseline exact-pose geometry but allow a monotonic working arc and return by reversing. Remove full-turn and rotating-crank class requirements together; retain branch consistency, original poses, at least 15 degree target and 10 degree working-arc transmission. This is a diagnostic mode, not an original-brief solution.

verification: Reproduce baseline source counters; independently evaluate 64 representative geometries per sampling configuration. For surviving candidates verify same branch and ordered target phases. Use analytic full-turn or working-arc assembly and transmission checks; sample carrier corners and link endpoints at 7201 phases for shortlisted panel screens.
panel_shortlist_budget: For each mode and direction, screen at most 128 candidates with fixed pivots inside the panel, ranked by smallest sum of link lengths. Retain full survivor counts; do not imply all survivors were panel-screened.
limits: No learned-model training; no published engine changes. Bounded diagnostics on a known development case are not a feasibility proof or general performance evaluation.
